subject: DPIA: CareBridge — data flow & retention details requested
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@carebridge.health>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: privacy@carebridge.health
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 16:15:00 +0000
Subject: DPIA template — CareBridge request (deadline 9/20)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As part of our procurement for the clinical notes summarization pilot, our privacy office needs a completed DPIA. I attached our standard DPIA template (CareBridge_DPIA_Template.xlsx). Can your team complete the template with:

- high-level data flows (ingress/egress, any third-party storage),
- data retention and deletion policies for PHI-derived outputs,
- list of subprocessors and subprocessors' locations,
- legal basis for processing (GDPR article references) and SCCs applicability,
- security controls and mitigations for the highest risk items (access controls, encryption-in-transit & at-rest, key management),
- evidence pointers (SOC 2 report, DPA sections, pen test summary).

Our target for review is 20 Sep (we need the completed XLSX by then). If you prefer, we can do a 30-minute call with our privacy lead (I can invite them) to walk through any ambiguous items.

Appreciate a quick note on timeline and a point of contact from your compliance/legal side.

Best,
Lina Torres
Privacy Program Manager
CareBridge Health

Attachment: CareBridge_DPIA_Template.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 72KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@carebridge.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA template — CareBridge request (deadline 9/20)

Hi Lina — thanks for sending this over and for the helpful list.

Plan:
1) I’ve attached an initial draft (RB_DPIA_QA_draft.xlsx) with placeholder answers where we need compliance/legal sign-off.
2) Neha (Compliance) and Monica (Solutions) are looped in to provide the detailed controls, subprocessors, and a data-flow diagram.
3) We’ll attach the redacted SOC 2 report and our standard DPA excerpts alongside the completed DPIA.

We can hit 20 Sep if we get to a short call this week to clarify two items: how CareBridge defines "derivative PHI" outputs retention (project vs. product retention), and whether pseudonymized records count as "personal data" for this pilot in your interpretation. If a call helps, how about Fri 12 Sep 10:00–10:30 PDT / 18:00–18:30 CET?

Next steps: Neha — can you review the attached draft and add source-of-truth links and artifacts? Monica — can you confirm the default retention windows we should propose for pilot data and whether we need an additional clause for patient re-identification requests? Lina — if the time above doesn’t work, propose times and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Healthcare
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RB_DPIA_QA_draft.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 45KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@carebridge.health>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA template — CareBridge request (deadline 9/20)

Thanks for the tag, Karthik. I reviewed the draft and added granularity on the following:

- Data flow: attached data_flow_diagram_v2.png showing ingestion (TLS), ephemeral KV-cache on GPU hosts, encrypted object storage for logs and queued inputs. Note: we purge KV cache after session end and rotate keys per our KMS schedule.
- Retention: for pilot we propose 30 days for raw inputs and 90 days for cached outputs unless explicit longer retention is agreed and included in the SOW. We marked the fields in the XLSX.
- Subprocessors: see attached subprocessors_list.csv — includes cloud infra provider (region-specific), logging provider (EU-only processing for CareBridge), telemetry vendor (aggregated only).
- Legal basis & SCCs: we reference Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interest for platform provisioning plus Article 9 exemptions for health data only when a lawful basis is confirmed by you; we will sign SCCs where required and propose the DPA addendum we use for healthcare customers.
- Evidence: RB_SOC2_Report_redacted.pdf attached; for penetration test summary, I linked the internal ticket but can extract a customer-friendly summary if you need it.

Open items for CareBridge: confirmation on whether the pilot will include patient identifiers that would require special handling under local law (we noted this in the XLSX). Also confirm whether CareBridge will act as joint-controller or controller-processor for the pilot.

If you’d like, I can join the call on Fri; I’m available 09:00–11:30 PDT.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: subprocessors_list.csv (CSV, 5KB), data_flow_diagram_v2.png (PNG, 120KB), RB_SOC2_Report_redacted.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@carebridge.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA template — CareBridge request (deadline 9/20)

Hi Lina — attaching the completed DPIA draft per your template. Key notes up front:

- We proposed pilot retention: 30 days for raw inputs, 90 days for derived outputs; we flagged where CareBridge may request exceptions.
- Subprocessors list and regions included; CareBridge-specific routing to EU-only logging has been noted.
- SOC 2 (redacted) and DPA excerpt attached; we confirmed we are willing to sign SCCs and propose the standard DPA addendum.
- Open items: controller role confirmation and whether CareBridge will provide a list of patient-identifier fields for the pilot.

Next steps: if the DPIA looks good we can finalize and I can route a DPA addendum for signature. If you want Neha to prepare a short evidence pack (pen-test summary + control mappings), she can produce that by 9/23.

Thanks for the fast turnaround — let me know if you want a short wrap-up call (I suggest 20–30 min).

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Healthcare
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CareBridge_DPIA_Completed_Draft.xlsx, RB_SOC2_Report_redacted.pdf
